prompt_meta.title: Mobile Premium UI Module 1: Design System + Auth + Onboarding (ONLY) with Evidence

product_identity.quality_bar: Best-in-class Korean consumer app UI (premium, intuitive, comfortable)

owner_actions.instruction: Review screenshots only and respond with: APPROVE_UI or UI_CHANGES_REQUESTED (bullets). No command execution.

step_objectives.goal: Make Mobile Auth + Onboarding look and feel premium, modern, and intuitive using a real design system. Do NOT redesign Games/Clubs/Venues yet.
outcomes: A mobile design system foundation (tokens + reusable components) that can be reused by future modules
Premium Auth screens (Login/Signup/Forgot/Logout states as applicable) with polished UX
Premium Onboarding flow with progress, clear steps, and friendly guidance
Loading, error, and empty states for Auth/Onboarding API interactions
Evidence screenshots from Android emulator showing the UI quality
All gates pass and changes pushed to GitHub main
constraints: No new backend features. Minor API/UI fixes allowed only if required for Auth/Onboarding UX correctness.
Do not change Games/Clubs/Venues/Chat/Notifications/Profile UI in this step except minimal compile fixes.
definition_of_done: Mobile design tokens exist and are applied across Auth + Onboarding
Auth + Onboarding screens look premium (not scaffolding) and are comfortable to use
Android emulator screenshots prove the new UI

allowed_to_modify: apps/mobile (theme, UI components, auth screens, onboarding screens, navigation only as needed for auth/onboarding)
packages/shared (translation keys only, no unrelated edits)
ops docs (design system notes and UI module docs)
must_not_modify: apps/api (unless absolutely required for auth/onboarding correctness; if changed, must be minimal and documented)

ux_basics: consistent spacing and typography across screens

screens: Forgot Password (if exists) OR a premium placeholder with clear copy if not supported
Logged-in state (profile shortcut or redirect behavior) must feel smooth

onboarding_module_requirements.ux_pattern: multi-step onboarding with progress indicator (stepper or progress bar)
steps_minimum: Skill level per sport (simple, clean UI)
must_have: success completion animation or premium transition (lightweight)

accessibility_basics: screen reader labels on primary interactive elements
microinteractions: skeletons for loading instead of blank screens

evidence_assets_required: At least 14 Android screenshots showing: Login, Signup, Loading, Error, Onboarding step 1-5, Success completion, Resume onboarding after restart
At least 1 screenshot showing emulator running (AVD name visible in some form or documented)
Short logs proving commands executed (stdout_tail in report)
proof_and_evidence_requirements.evidence_storage_rule: All screenshots/logs must be stored under reports/assets/STEP-0019/ and referenced in report.

tasks.name: Create mobile design system foundation
tasks.objective: Implement tokens + reusable components required for premium UI and apply them to Auth/Onboarding only.
acceptance: Tokens + components exist and are used in Auth/Onboarding screens

tasks.name: Upgrade Auth screens to premium UI
tasks.objective: Rewrite Auth screens using the design system with validation, loading/error states, and premium layout.
acceptance: Screens look premium; auth flow still works

tasks.name: Upgrade Onboarding screens to premium UI
tasks.objective: Make onboarding a multi-step guided flow with progress indicator, validation, resume support, and premium transitions.
constraints: No new backend features; minimal fixes only if needed
acceptance: Onboarding feels guided and polished; gating still works

tasks.name: Run Android emulator + capture screenshots evidence
tasks.objective: Boot emulator, run the app, navigate through Auth + Onboarding, capture required screenshots.
acceptance: Evidence assets saved and referenced in report

tasks.name: Quality gates + push to GitHub
tasks.objective: Run integrity/lint/test/build, fix issues, commit and push to main.
acceptance: All gates pass; push evidence included

acceptance_checklist.requirement: Onboarding premium multi-step with progress + resume

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do NOT redesign multiple modules. Only create a premium mobile design system foundation and rebuild Auth + Onboarding UI to best-in-class quality. Capture Android emulator screenshots as proof. Keep localization correct, run all gates, push to GitHub main, update ops/manifest.json, and write reports/STEP-0019.report.json with no placeholders.
